systems.owner: National Digital ID Program; registration and card printing by Ethio telecom as a partner since 24 April 2024
systems.tiers: Ethio telecom service centres, franchise outlets and mobile registration teams in all 12 regions and two city administrations: 119 zones (98%), 986 woredas (79%), 1,376 cities, over 3,340 active registration kits

note: Ethio telecom's annual report; its only content in the study's field is national identity enrolment (nearly 32 million registered since April 2024, 69% of all registrations), an identity system, and it says nothing of civil registration.
